name: openEDMDelay
description: A beat-synced eight-tap delay with ping-pong, digital, tape, BBD and lo-fi characters, selectable high/low-pass slopes, ducking and glitch effects.

name: openWallLimiter
description: Five limiter characters, selectable high/low-pass filters, true-peak protection and loudness metering. Hold the line on your final mix.

name: openGlitchFX
description: A beat-synced playground for stutters, reversals and rhythmic disruption. Shape the unexpected across 32 steps.

name: openEDMFilter
description: Two expressive multimode filters with tempo-synced modulation, envelope followers and a little extra edge.

name: openSausage
description: Saturation, reverb, rising pitch and stereo width. Four simple controls for sound with character.

name: openDucker
description: One knob for host-synced rhythmic ducking. Four recovery slopes, six beat rates, and DJ Duck on the decks.

name: openTunerEQ
description: A five-band musical equalizer. Tune by note, snap to the chromatic scale and shape frequencies at the piano.

name: openMaster
description: Studio 84 mastering rack with filters, tone EQ, stereo shaping, compression, dynamic EQ, saturation, clipping, limiting, and loudness meters.

name: Winamp Classic Equalizer
description: The familiar ten-band equalizer, reimagined as a plugin with 4Front EQ10 and Constant-Q modes.
notice: See the project README for provenance and usage terms.

name: Winamp Classic Visualizer
description: A classic spectrum analyzer and oscilloscope for your session. Familiar movement, in a modern plugin.
